opening.argument: The video walks viewers through adding a complaint in an IndianOil helpdesk, opening the new service request option, viewing complaints, attaching a file, and submitting the ticket. The displayed service-request and attachment screens place these actions within an instructional complaint-management workflow, while the submitted request view reflects the stated operational process. The speaker explains that “today example we will add complaint in the helpdis” and directs viewers to “Click on submit ticket.” The request to subscribe and like is ordinary audience engagement and is not connected to a financial or credential-based offer.
